description.value: The City Centre Branch of the Coquitlam Public Library is a full-service public branch located in the heart of Coquitlam's City Centre neighbourhood. It offers programs for all ages, a library lounge, room bookings, computers and printing, and an extensive digital collection. For touring cyclists moving through the Tri-Cities area, it represents a potential urban rest stop with public services.
